text: There are charges on my card {card} RIGHT NOW from a store in another country, a new one every few minutes. I am at home and the card is in my hand. Please stop this immediately. Call me on {phone}.
This morning I found two e-transfers of $600 each that I never sent, both to someone I have never heard of. I changed my password straight away. My name is {name} and I want the $1,200 returned.
I got a credit card statement for a card I never applied for. Someone opened it in my name using my address, {address}. I think my identity has been stolen. Please investigate. {name}

Someone phoned pretending to be from your fraud department and the number looked like yours. They asked me for the code you texted me and I gave it. Then $3,400 left my savings. How did your security let this happen?
theres a 9.99 charge from some streaming service on my card every month since june and i never signed up for it. i dont even know what it is

My father is 84 and lives alone. A man who says he is a bank investigator keeps calling him and has convinced him to withdraw cash three times this week, $2,000 each time. He is going to do it again tomorrow. His account number is {account}. I am his daughter, {name}, reachable at {email}.
unauthorized atm withdrawal $500 yesterday 11pm. wasnt me. card was in my wallet.

My phone suddenly lost service and when I got it back someone had logged into my online banking, changed my email and phone number, and is moving money out. I can't log in to stop it. This is {name}, please freeze everything now. My other number is {phone}.
My debit card keeps getting declined at the grocery store even though there's plenty of money in the account. This is the fourth time in two weeks and it's embarrassing.
I reported my card lost three weeks ago and the replacement still hasn't arrived. I can move money in the app but I can't pay in shops. Can you check where it is? It should go to {address}.

I disputed a $280 purchase six weeks ago because the furniture was never delivered. The merchant won't answer and your dispute team keeps saying it is 'in progress'. I paid for something I never got. Card {card}.

I am travelling in Portugal and you blocked my credit card for 'suspicious activity' even though I told you about the trip. I have no other card, I can't pay for my hotel tonight and I'm stuck. Please unblock it. {name}, {phone}
Hello, the ATM at the mall kept my card this afternoon. Could you please let me know how I get it back or order a new one? Thank you.
My new card came in the mail but the PIN letter never did. Can you send it again?
The tap feature doesn't work on my new card, I have to insert it every time. Minor but annoying.
Your ATM swallowed my card last Friday and then you charged me a $25 replacement fee for it. That's your machine's fault, not mine. I want a free replacement and the fee reversed. {name}
I sent an e-transfer of $350 to my landlord on Monday and four days later it still says pending. Now he wants a $50 late fee from me. Please sort this out. {name}, {phone}

I wired $8,000 to my real estate lawyer's trust account for my house closing two days ago and they still haven't received it. The closing is tomorrow. I need to know where the money is today. Reference account {account}.
I paid my hydro bill through online banking but the money went to a different payee with a similar name. Now hydro says I'm late. How do I get the $142.60 back?
I typed one digit wrong and sent $600 to the wrong account. I called the same day and was told it would be recalled but it's been a week. The account I meant was {account}.
My employer says my pay was deposited on Friday but it is not in my account. Rent is due on the 1st and I have nothing to pay it with. Please find my $2,300 payroll deposit. {name}, {email}
Hi, my automatic monthly transfer to savings didn't happen this month. Not urgent, just wanted to flag it. Thanks!
I sent money to my mother in India nine days ago and it still hasn't arrived. Your website said 2 to 3 business days. She needs it for her medicine.
My credit card payment of $780 went through twice from my chequing account, which put me into overdraft, and now there's an overdraft fee too. Please reverse the duplicate payment.
I have been locked out of my account for two weeks. Every password reset locks it again. My paycheque is in there and I can't buy groceries. I've called five times. {name}
The password reset email never arrives. I checked spam. My email is {email}.
You closed my account without any warning and my $4,000 is frozen. Nobody can tell me why. I need that money for my bills this month. Account {account}.
I am trying to open a chequing account. The branch has asked me to bring my documents three separate times and each time someone says something else is missing. I have been trying for a month.
I changed my phone number and now the two step verification codes go to my old number so I can't sign in. I updated it at the branch but it still isn't working. New number is {phone}.

My father passed away in March and I am the executor of his estate. I have sent the death certificate and the will twice and I still cannot access his account to pay the funeral home. Every call I have to explain it all again. {name}
cant log in. again. third time this month

My partner removed me from our joint account and changed the online banking password. He controls all the money now and I have nothing for my kids. I'm scared for my safety if he finds out I'm contacting you. Please only use this email: {email}
A $15.95 monthly fee started showing up on my statement in September. Nobody told me and my package was supposed to be free. I want it refunded.
I was charged three overdraft fees of $48 each on the same day even though I have overdraft protection on my account {account}. That's $144 for nothing.
I paid my full credit card balance before the due date but I was still charged $37 interest. I have the confirmation. Please explain and refund.
You put a hold on my cheque deposit and then charged me a $45 NSF fee when my rent payment bounced because of your hold. The money was there. Reverse the fee please.
I noticed a $3.12 foreign transaction fee on a purchase. I don't remember being told about this fee. Can you explain where it is in my agreement?

This is the third month in a row your fees have pushed me into overdraft and then you charge me more fees for being overdrawn. If this isn't fixed I am filing a complaint with the banking ombudsman. {name}
Why was I charged $3 for using one of your own ATMs? It was a Maple Harbour Bank machine.
FEES FEES FEES. MONTHLY FEE, E-TRANSFER FEE, PAPER STATEMENT FEE. I HAVE BEEN WITH YOU FOR 20 YEARS AND I AM SICK OF IT. I WANT THEM ALL REFUNDED OR I AM MOVING MY ACCOUNTS.

I lost my job in August and I can't make my mortgage payment. I don't know how I'm going to feed my kids. I can't sleep and honestly I don't see the point of anything anymore. Please, is there anything you can do. {name}
My mortgage payment of $1,850 was taken twice this month. That left me short for everything else. I want the duplicate returned today. Mortgage number {account}.
I applied for a car loan six weeks ago and I still have no decision. The dealer will not hold the car much longer. Every time I call I am told it is with underwriting.
I sold my house and you charged me a $4,200 prepayment penalty on my mortgage. Nobody explained this when I signed and the calculation makes no sense to me. I want it reviewed.
My car loan statement shows a balance $640 higher than my own records. I have made every payment on time. Can someone go through it with me? {name}, {phone}
My mortgage renewal letter arrived after the renewal date so I was put on a higher rate automatically. I would have chosen a different term if I had received it on time.
The rate on my line of credit went up and I only found out from my statement. I expected a notice before it changed.

I received a letter saying you will start foreclosure on my home at {address} for missed payments. I have not missed a single payment and I have the bank statements to prove it. I have given everything to my lawyer and we will take legal action if this is not withdrawn this week.
The website takes forever to load my e-statements, sometimes a minute or more. It works in the end but it's frustrating.
Since the last update the mobile app crashes every time I open it. I can't check my balance or pay bills. I've reinstalled it twice.
Online banking was down for two whole days last week and I missed a credit card payment because of it. Now I have a $29 late fee from the card company. Who pays for that?
Mobile cheque deposit keeps rejecting my cheque, says the image is unclear. I've tried in daylight three times. I don't have time to go to a branch.
The app showed my balance as zero yesterday and I panicked. Today it shows the right amount. What happened? Is my money safe?

I am blind and use a screen reader. Since your app redesign the screen reader can't read the buttons on the transfer screen, so I can't move my own money without asking someone for help. Please fix the accessibility. {name}, {email}
app login screen just spins and spins
I get the same push notification about a promotion five times a day and I can't find where to turn it off.
I waited 50 minutes at the Harbourfront branch and when I finally reached the counter the teller rolled her eyes and told me to use the app. Terrible service.
the teller at king st was rude to me when i asked a simple question about my statement. she laughed and walked away. not ok
I called your contact centre three times today and was disconnected every time after waiting over 30 minutes. This keeps happening. {name}, {phone}

When I asked for help the advisor made a comment about my accent and said I should 'learn proper English before opening accounts'. Other customers heard it. I felt humiliated and I want this addressed.
The branch on Elm Street was closed at 2pm on a Tuesday even though the sign and your website say it's open until 5.

My mother is 79 and has early dementia. An advisor at your branch sold her a five-year locked investment with her entire savings while I was not there. She does not understand what she signed. I am her daughter {name}.
Three weeks ago a manager promised to call me back within 48 hours about my account. Nobody has called. I've left two more messages.
Your security guard grabbed my arm and pushed me out of the branch because I was 'loitering' while waiting for my wife. I am reporting this to the regulator and I want the footage kept.

I received a bank statement in the mail today that belongs to another customer, {name2}, with his account number and balance on it. If you are sending his to me, who is getting mine? I live at {address}.
Someone at your branch told my ex-husband my new address and my account balance when he came in asking about me. We are separated and he is not on my accounts. How could this happen? {name}
45 days ago I asked in writing for a copy of all the personal information you hold about me. I've had no response at all. Please treat this as a formal follow-up. {name}, {email}
I opted out of marketing calls last year but you still call me about credit cards every week at {phone}. Stop using my number for this.
I just got an email from your mortgage team that had about 200 other customers' email addresses visible in the To field. Mine is {email}. This is a data breach.
I saw on the news that a company you work with had a data breach. Was my information included? Nobody has told me anything.
You reported a missed payment to the credit bureau that never happened, and now my credit score has dropped and my mortgage pre-approval was refused. Correct the record. {name}, SIN {sin}
I closed all my accounts last year. Please delete my personal information and confirm in writing.
BEST PRICES on luxury watches!!! Visit our store today for 70% off, limited time only, click the link in our profile.
What are your branch hours over the holiday weekend?
the thing with the stuff from before is happening again, same as last time
I just wanted to say {name} at the Westdale branch was wonderful today and sorted out everything in ten minutes. Please pass on my thanks.
My phone company overcharged me again this month and their customer service is useless. Can you believe it?
I'm just unhappy with everything lately. Nothing works the way it should.
Why has the price of groceries gone up so much this year? Is the bank doing something about inflation?
Hello, I would like to apply for a teller job at your bank. Who should I send my resume to? {name}, {phone}
